name: Large pelagic fish
description: Large pelagic fishes - tunas, bonitos, pompanos, barracudas, dolphinfishes and their open-water kin (14 genera in the source's list). Functional group pooling the source's 'Pelagic L' compartment - the guild of large roaming predators whose seasonal migrations carry them along the whole Mauritanian shelf; it imports 2.1% of its diet from outside the modelled system.
